programmes.d: A man is found dead in a motel room due to multiple shotgun wounds. Dr. G proves the scene isn’t what it seems.
Rusty Updike has asked his ex-wife Vesta on a cruise. The couple hasn’t seen each other for 15 years but Vesta decides that a cruise with her ex might make for a nice change of pace.
Recent college grad Robert Terrible is out drinking at a club with friends celebrating. At 3 AM, he realizes he better call it a night and heads to the nearby garage where he parked his car.
It’s an early Sunday morning when a local resident decides to take a shortcut through the church parking lot. Walking past a lone car, the resident can’t believe his eyes.
It is 3 AM and Deputy Torres is cruising a Texas highway when he suddenly spots a crushed pick-up truck along the side of the road. Trapped inside is the lifeless body of 24-year-old Luis Reyes.
Carol Moleskie agrees to go on a hunting excursion with her husband, Bob. A few hours after they enter the woods, they emerge again, Bob frantically waving down traffic as he carries his bloody wife.
The farmers enjoy the final morning of the trip before choosing who they'll take on the next dates.
The ladies get a shocking surprise when they meet their potential in-laws at a special supper.
In the last-ever solo dates, the farmers have one last chance to see where their feelings lie.
The farmers hit the road to visit the first of their two ladies' families.
The four farmers embark on round two of meeting their potential future in-laws.
There's tears, love, and heartbreak as the farmers offer their hearts to the woman of their dreams.
Host Jennifer Nettles and the cast debrief their farm life journey and their quest to find love.
A young boy is taken to the ER after being in a horrific accident. His head is severed and doctors race to save his life.
A man is rushed into the ER with a 16 inch bar protruding from his neck; doctors try to figure out how they can remove it.
A young boy's feet have been crushed by a train, and the ER surgeons have to work really hard to save his life.
A woman who inhaled toxic fumes now believes her neighbors want to kill her.
A circus sword swallower suffers from a case of hiccups. A mother and daughter mysteriously collapse.
An ER doctor's friend arrives at the hospital combative and out of control, attacking the doctor in the ER.
A young girl, recently hit by a hockey puck, is now mysteriously paralyzed from the waist down.
Doctors use a robot operated by a specialist at another hospital to treat a seizing 7-year-old boy.
A surgeon requires urgent treatment after falling off a bed while trying to help his patient.
A young boy at a sleepover party mysteriously loses control of his arms and legs.
A knifing victim suddenly starts seizing and his doctors can't treat him until they figure out the cause.
A young woman in labor begs the ER doctor to keep her pregnancy and delivery a secret from her father.
It’s a late night and a Vietnam veteran with a history of mental illness is drunk and stumbling through an apartment complex. When the police arrive, he pulls a gun and shoots himself in the head.
Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.
When the husband, Tao Chen, is shot to death by his wife Jun, she claims she pulled the trigger in self-defense when a drunken Tao came after her with a gun.
